title: USACE Portland District Dredges Slops Services
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > NWD > W071 ENDIST PORTLAND
description:
THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. 

 THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR BIDS/PROPOSAL. 

  PROJECT:  FY27 USACE Portland District Dredge Slops removal services 

 No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this notice or any follow-up information requests. 

 This is a SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE for  market research ONLY  to determine the availability of firms interested in this work and gauge interest in providing pricing for a 12-month base contract with four (4)-12month option years. This is not a request for pricing but rather an inquiry about whether firms would be able to provide pricing once an official solicitation is posted. 

 This notification serves three purposes: (1) to notify potential Offerors of the Government's intent to solicit a future project; (2) to identify potential sources that can provide these services; (3) notification of USACE’s intent to award a base contract for 12months with 4-12month option years. The bidding firms will be required to provide pricing for a firm-fixed-price contract for one (1)-12month base contract and four (4)-12month option years. 

 SUMMARY OF REQUIREMENT: US Army Corp of Engineers, Portland District requires multiple slops removal services from Dredge Vessel Yaquina and Dredge Vessel Essayons. Each removal may require up to 2,500 gallons of slops for the Yaquina and up to 4,500 gallons of slops for the Essayons. There will be multiple potential locations for each vessel for performance of removal services throughout the performance period. The Government intends to award a firm-fixed-price contract for these services.  

  Interested vendors please provide the following no later than 30 November 2026 at 12:00PM Pacific to Jaren Bowman at Jaren.L.Bowman@usace.army.mil and Ian Lutjens at Ian.k.lutjens@usace.army.mil:  

 
	 Vendor name 
	 Cage Code/Unique Entity ID  
	 Point of contact name and contact information 
	 Capability Statement 
 

 This is a market survey and notification of intent only. This is not a request to respond to a solicitation. A determination by the Government to compete the proposed contract based upon responses to this notice is solely at the discretion of the Government.
